author: reek
body: Scene management for the star map. The camera exists in 3D parsec space and can fly freely. Stars are rendered as screen-space points whose size depends on apparent magnitude adjusted for camera distance. Deep-sky objects get icons. The scene handles frustum culling, level of detail, and selection.

author: reek
body: Camera uses yaw/pitch/distance from a focus point. WASD moves the focus, mouse orbits, scroll zooms. Double-click selects and flies to an object.
